dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000sy8k](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000sy8k) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 23.374 depth occurred on May 16 2026 30km SE of Manaoba Island. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -8.5526 longitude 160.9161. It impacted 62195 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
